summary: The current Android build works on Flutter 3.47.5 / AGP 9.1.0 with android.builtInKotlin=false, but Flutter warns about flutter_background, flutter_webrtc and livekit_client applying KGP. A no-device Gradle probe with android.builtInKotlin=true fails while configuring flutter_background 1.3.1 because it unconditionally applies kotlin-android, which AGP 9 rejects when built-in Kotlin is active. Keep the current compatibility mode until all three declarations have been migrated and both modes are covered by Android CI.

checks.name: Current Android Debug build with built-in Kotlin disabled
checks.command: cd desktop && JAVA_HOME=<JDK 17> flutter build apk --debug --no-pub
checks.observation: Debug APK builds successfully without connecting to or installing on a device. Flutter 3.47.5 emits its KGP warning for flutter_background, flutter_webrtc and livekit_client.

checks.name: AGP 9 built-in Kotlin compatibility probe
checks.observation: Gradle 9.3.1 / AGP 9.1.0 fails at flutter_background 1.3.1 android/build.gradle line 3. The plugin applies kotlin-android unconditionally; AGP reports KGP is no longer required with built-in Kotlin and instructs removing org.jetbrains.kotlin.android. No device was used.

checks.name: Local plugin and resolved dependency source audit
checks.observation: The app does not directly apply KGP. flutter_webrtc and livekit_client conditionally skip their apply statement when AGP 9 built-in Kotlin is active, but Flutter's detector still warns because the plugin declarations remain in the source. The first built-in-Kotlin configuration failure is flutter_background; a fully migrated three-plugin build matrix has not been completed.

remaining: Migrate flutter_background, flutter_webrtc and livekit_client plugin build scripts without regressing the false-mode compatibility, add CI builds for builtInKotlin=false and true, then switch the default only after both Debug and signed Release gates pass.
